correctness.rationale: For n>=6, the noncover complex of the tight 3-uniform cycle is the ordinary 3-cut complex of complement C_n. Kim–Kim Theorem 3.4 provides the nonequivariant concentration in d_n=2k−2 with rank3 for n=4k, otherwise d_n=2k−1 rank1. Equivariant combinatorial Alexander duality gives χ(g)=(-1)^(c(g)+d_n)F(g), with F the signed orbit-subset sum over cyclic words avoiding 111. The 4×4 rotation transfer matrix has characteristic x(x−1)(x²+1), independently reconstructed exactly; the reflected half-path sums satisfy T_L=(-1)^floor(L/2) (checked to L=34 and supported by transfer recurrence). This yields χ(r^j)=3 if n=4k and 4|j else −1 in the n=4k case; χ(sr^j)=(-1)^(k+1+j), with 1 and (-1)^k for nonzero residues. Fresh independent direct orbit-sum enumerations verified every dihedral element at all n=6..15, not an all-n substitute.
residual_risks: Uniform result uses published integral wedge classification, and equivariant Alexander-duality orientation signs
Finite n enumerations corroborate transfer proof, not proof for every n
